test_dynamic_mixin: test the dynamic_mixin function to apply a new class to an existing object at runtime
test_init: test the dynamic_mixin function with init_new_class to call dynamic_mixin_init on the mixed in class
test_remove: test the remove_dynamic_mixin function to restore an object to its original class after dynamic mixin
test_override: test that a dynamically mixed in class overrides methods from the original class
refactor_dynamic_mixin: refactor the dynamic_mixin function to support additional initialization parameters or multiple mixin classes
